customManagers.description: Track the shared Komodo Core / Periphery pin; bootstrap and the arm systemd agent are upgraded manually together.

packageRules.description: Pin bundled Postgres and Redis digests in cloudreve, n8n, and umami so updates within a major tag change compose.yaml and trigger Komodo's deploy-if-changed flow.
Topic Docker image PRs by the bare image name (Renovate's default prepends a 'dependency ' noun).
Mastodon ships its web/sidekiq image and the streaming image in lockstep at the same version, so group their updates into one PR.
Sure ships web and Sidekiq worker from the same image, so group their updates into one PR.
Multica ships its backend and web images in lockstep at the same version, so group their updates into one PR. The stack's pgvector image is not under this namespace and keeps its own PRs.

LinuxServer.io tags carry an -lsNN rebuild counter (emby: 4.9.5.0-ls283); default docker versioning treats that suffix as a compatibility variant that must match exactly, so updates are never offered. Parse the tag explicitly instead.

Silo (MinIO fork) tags are RELEASE.2026-09-16T00-00-00Z. Default docker versioning reads only the leading number and treats the rest as a variant suffix that must match exactly, so no update would ever be offered. Parse date as major.minor.patch and the time as build; the anchors also exclude the -distroless / -arm64 / -amd64 variants.

Muvyo runs `latest` because its in-container OTA plugin updates ahead of any pinned tag, so tracked PRs would always arrive stale (stacks/muvyo/compose.yaml, docs/conventions.md). Disable the datasource entirely so Renovate opens no version or digest PRs for it.
Same for the cliproxyapi stack: Oh My CPA's updater container updates both OMC and CPA in place from its console, so they run `latest` (stacks/cliproxyapi/compose.yaml).

Same for miaomiaowu: its UI's updater writes a new binary to /app/data/server and the entrypoint prefers that over the image's /app/server, so a pinned tag would always lag the live version and every bump PR would arrive stale (stacks/miaomiaowu/compose.yaml).
Same LinuxServer.io problem for kometa, whose tags look like v2.4.4-ls103.
